page.overview:
What is Lorekeepers of the Whills?

The Lorekeepers of the Whills where an organization that was associated with the Whills. The Sith Lord Darth Plagueis had read that the Lorekeepers had mastered the ability to appear to others in the physical realm after death while being able to see and hear. Plagueis wrote his findings, as well as that knoweldge of the Whills was difficult to uncover for those who wished it, in the book Book of Sith.

Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side
